AboutPage.title: Our
AboutPage.subtitle: We are building the trust layer for the B2B IT service industry.
AboutPage.problem1: For too long, IT agencies and software houses have struggled with delayed payments, scope creep, and chaotic client communication. Clients, on the other hand, worry about missing deadlines and vaporware.
AboutPage.problem2: Traditional project management tools tell you what needs to be done, but they do nothing to enforce the agreement between the buyer and the seller.
AboutPage.enter1: We created Crave to bridge this gap. By tightly coupling project management with milestone-based escrow locks, we ensure that agencies get paid for their hard work, and clients get exactly what they paid for.
AboutPage.missionDesc: To eradicate unpaid IT invoices and restore trust in digital service delivery worldwide.
AboutPage.visionDesc: A future where every B2B digital contract is self-enforcing, transparent, and fair for all parties involved.
